app.learn.bb.l1.title: Da gaske kana samun kuɗi?
app.learn.bb.l1.story1: Aisha tana da ƙaramin shagon tufafi. Yau ta sayar da ₦50,000 kuma tana komawa gida cikin farin ciki.
app.learn.bb.l1.story3: Sayarwa tana ji kamar nasara — amma shin daidai take da riba?
app.learn.bb.l1.chooseExplain: Sayarwa ba daidai take da riba ba. Idan ta kashe ₦35,000 a kan kaya, ribar duka ita ce ₦15,000 (₦50,000 − ₦35,000).
app.learn.bb.l1.mathInsight: Ribar duka a kan sayarwa = kuɗin da ya shigo − abin da sayarwar ta ɗauke ka.
app.learn.bb.l1.calcQ: Ka sayar a kan ₦10,000. Ya ɗauke ka ₦7,000. Menene ribar ka ta duka?
app.learn.bb.l2.title: Sayarwa ≠ riba
app.learn.bb.l2.salesQ: Wace lamba ke gaya maka nawa ka sayar?
app.learn.bb.l2.salesExplain: Sayarwa kuɗi ne da abokan ciniki suka biya ka — kafin kuɗaɗe.
app.learn.bb.l2.profitQ: Wace lamba ke gaya maka abin da ya rage bayan kuɗaɗe?
app.learn.bb.l2.profitExplain: Riba ita ce abin da ya rage bayan farashin kaya da sauran kuɗaɗen kasuwanci.
app.learn.bb.l2.compareQ: Wane kasuwanci ya samu riba mafi girma?
app.learn.bb.l3.title: Littafin rubutun ka shine ƙwaƙwalwar kasuwancin ka
app.learn.bb.l3.story1: Musa ya shafe shekara uku yana gudanar da shagonsa.
app.learn.bb.l3.story2: Wani ya tambaya: “Nawa ka samu a watan jiya?”
app.learn.bb.l3.story4: Ƙwaƙwalwar ka ba tsarin lissafi ba ce.
app.learn.bb.l3.insight: Masu kasuwanci da ke rubuta abubuwa sun san abin da ke faruwa da gaske — ba abin da suke tsammani ba.
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseQ: Wa ya fi sanin abin da ke faruwa a kasuwancin?
app.learn.bb.l3.chooseExplain: Rubuce-rubucen yau da kullum suna cin nasara kan ƙwaƙwalwa kowane lokaci.
app.learn.bb.l3.missionHint: Rubuta sayarwa 5 na gaba a TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l4.title: Kowace sayarwa tana da labari
app.learn.bb.l4.intro: Rubutu mai kyau yana amsa: me aka sayar, nawa, yaushe, ga wa, yaya suka biya, kuma shin akwai abin da har yanzu ake bi bashi.
app.learn.bb.l4.amountQ: Ka rubuta “₦25,000” kawai — shin hakan ya isa?
app.learn.bb.l4.amountB: A'a — cikakken rubutu yana ba da labarin kuɗin
app.learn.bb.l4.amountExplain: Kuɗi kaɗai ba ya gaya maka kaya, abokin ciniki, biyan kuɗi, ko bashi.
app.learn.bb.l4.checklist: Me · Nawa · Yaushe · Abokin ciniki · Hanyar biya · An biya duka? · Akwai abin da ake bi bashi?
app.learn.bb.l4.missionHint: Buɗe Rubuta → Sayarwa ka ajiye sayarwa ɗaya ta gaske a TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l5.title: Buɗe shagon ka kamar ƙwararre
app.learn.bb.l5.routine: Buɗewa ta minti 5: ☑ Duba kuɗi · ☑ Kaya masu muhimmanci · ☑ Umarnin yau · ☑ Abokan ciniki da ke bin bashi · ☑ Burin sayarwar yau
app.learn.bb.l5.openQ: Shagon ka ya buɗe yanzu. Me ya kamata ka fara yi?
app.learn.bb.l5.openB: Duba abin da kasuwancin ke buƙata yau
app.learn.bb.l5.openExplain: Dubawa mai sauri yana shirya ka don sayarwa da guje wa abubuwan mamaki.
app.learn.bb.l6.title: Ina kuɗin ya tafi?
app.learn.bb.l6.story1: Aisha ta sayar da ₦80,000 — amma ₦15,000 kawai ya rage a lokacin rufewa.
app.learn.bb.l6.story2: Sufuri, abinci, kaya, wuta, kashe kuɗi na kai, ma'aikata… ko ba a sani ba?
app.learn.bb.l6.leaks: Kuɗi na iya fita ta kuɗaɗen kasuwanci, kaya, bashi, ko kashe kuɗi da ba a rubuta ba.
app.learn.bb.l6.teach: Idan ba ka rubuta inda kuɗi ke tafiya ba, kasuwancin ka na iya rasa kuɗi a hankali.
app.learn.bb.l6.missionTitle: Rubuta kashe kuɗin farko na yau
app.learn.bb.l6.missionHint: Rubuta kashe kuɗi ɗaya a TIJAR domin ka san inda kuɗin ya tafi.
app.learn.bb.l7.title: Kuɗin kasuwanci ≠ kuɗin kai
app.learn.bb.l7.story1: Kasuwancin Musa yana da ₦100,000. Aboki ya gayyace shi fita.
app.learn.bb.l7.withdrawExplain: Ɗaukar kuɗin shago don kan ka ba laifi ba ne kai tsaye — amma dole ka san menene shi ka rubuta shi da kyau.
app.learn.bb.l7.teach: Sanya wa cire kuɗi da kashe kuɗi suna domin hoton ribar ka ya kasance gaskiya.
app.learn.bb.l8.title: Rufe shagon kamar ƙwararre
app.learn.bb.l8.v1: Yau: Sayarwa ₦75,000 · Kashe kuɗi ₦18,000 · Bashin abokin ciniki ₦12,000
app.learn.bb.l8.v2: Kafin ka kulle, duba abin da ya faru.
app.learn.bb.l8.v3: Rufewa mai kyau = abubuwan mamaki kaɗan gobe.
app.learn.bb.l8.closeQ: Me ya kamata ka duba kafin rufewa?
app.learn.bb.l8.closeA: Sayarwa, kashe kuɗi, kuɗi/biyan kuɗi, da bashin abokin ciniki
app.learn.bb.l8.closeC: Ba komai — gobe wata rana ce
app.learn.bb.l8.closeExplain: Rufewa ta minti 5 tana sa rubuce-rubuce da kuɗi su kasance gaskiya.
app.learn.bb.l8.closingList: Rufewa ta minti 5: 1) Rubuta sayarwa 2) Rubuta kashe kuɗi 3) Duba kuɗi/biyan kuɗi 4) Duba bashin abokin ciniki 5) Duba aikin yau
app.learn.bb.l8.missionHint: Rubuta akalla sayarwa ɗaya yau domin ranar ka ta kasance a TIJAR.
app.learn.bb.l9.title: Kasuwancin ka yana da bugun zuciya
app.learn.bb.l9.intro: Kowane kasuwanci yana da lambobi kaɗan da ya kamata ka sani — ba tare da kalmomin lissafi masu wahala ba.
app.learn.bb.l9.debtQ: Wace lamba ke gaya maka abokan ciniki har yanzu suna bin ka?
app.learn.bb.l9.debtExplain: Bashin abokin ciniki (bashi) kuɗi ne da har yanzu ake bin kasuwancin ka.
app.learn.bb.l10.title: Mai kasuwanci na minti 10
app.learn.bb.l10.intro: Kana da minti 10 kafin buɗewa. Zaɓi ayyuka biyar na safe da suka fi muhimmanci.

app.learn.bb.l10.evening: Tsarin yamma: rubuta sayarwa · rubuta kashe kuɗi · rubuta bashi · duba biyan kuɗi · duba ranar.

app.learn.content.islTrade.q1c: Sayar da abin da ba ka da shi ba tare da faɗa ba
app.learn.content.islTrade.q2a: Yi gaskiya game da abin da abokin ciniki zai samu
app.learn.content.islRiba.q1: Riba (kuɗin ruwa) a sauƙaƙe ita ce…
app.learn.content.islRiba.q1c: Ƙari marar adalci a kan bashi ko biyan kuɗi da aka jinkirta
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2: Don bashin shago na yau da kullum, TIJAR yana taimaka maka…
app.learn.content.islRiba.q2a: Bi abin da ake bi bashi ba tare da dabarun ruwa da aka ɓoye ba
app.profile.verifiedBody: Za ka iya sayarwa da rubuta biyan kuɗi cikin aminci da TIJAR.
app.profile.unverifiedBody: Kammala bayanan kasuwancin ka don buɗe tabbatarwa.
app.profile.menuOrdersHint: Duba sayarwa ka bi abin da ka sayar
app.profile.menuProductsHint: Kula da jerin kayayyakin ka da kaya
app.profile.menuWalletHint: Duba bashin kuɗi da tarihin mu'amala
app.profile.menuBusinessHint: Sabunta bayanan shago da kasuwancin ka
app.profile.menuHelpHint: Samu taimako ko tuntubi ƙungiyar mu
app.profile.growBody: Sanya ƙarin kayayyaki, isa ga ƙarin abokan ciniki, kuma ka ƙara sayarwa da TIJAR.
app.profile.contactHint: Yadda abokan ciniki da TIJAR ke isa gare ka.
app.profile.bioHint: Gajeren layi game da kai ko kasuwancin ka.
app.profile.bioPlaceholder: Gina kasuwanci mafi kyau, dama ɗaya a lokaci guda.
app.profile.settings.accountHint: Sunan ka, hoto, da bayanan tuntuɓa.
app.profile.settings.securityBlurb: Yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi da ba ka rabawa. TIJAR ba ya taɓa neman kalmar sirrin ka ta saƙo ko waya.
app.profile.settings.sendResetLink: Aiko mini da hanyar sake saita ta imel
app.profile.settings.resetSent: Duba imel ɗin ka don hanyar sake saita.
app.profile.settings.oauthPassword: Ka shiga da Google. Kula da kalmar sirrin ka a asusun Google ɗin ka.
app.profile.settings.dangerHint: Cire asusun TIJAR ɗin ka da bayanan kasuwancin ka har abada.
app.profile.settings.deleteBody: Wannan yana cire bayanan ka, kasuwanci, kayayyaki, sayarwa, da abokan ciniki daga TIJAR. Ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
onboarding.revenue.subscription: Biyan kuɗi na yau da kullum
app.assistant.title: Yi magana da TIJAR
app.assistant.subtitle: Mai ajiye littafinka da murya
app.assistant.heroBody: Faɗi abin da ya faru a shagonka — sayarwa, kashe kuɗi, kayan da ka saya — TIJAR zai shirya maka rubutun.
app.assistant.tapMic: Taɓa maƙallan murya ka yi magana
app.assistant.unsupported: Murya ba ta aiki a wannan na'ura
app.assistant.micHint: Gajeren jumla ɗaya ya fi — nau'i, adadi da abin da aka yi.
app.assistant.typingWorks: Rubutawa a ƙasa yana aiki cikakke.
app.assistant.inputPlaceholder: Rubuta a maimakon… misali Rubuta sayarwa 5000 na shinkafa
app.assistant.nothingSaved: Ba a ajiye komai har sai ka tabbatar.
app.assistant.saveFailedReply: Yi haƙuri, ba na iya ajiye hakan. Sake gwadawa.
app.assistant.needBusinessReply: Kammala saita kasuwancinka tukuna, sannan zan iya bayyana lambobinka.
app.assistant.summaryUnknown: Ban fahimci adadi ko nau'i ba. Gwada: 'Rubuta sayarwa 5000 na shinkafa'.
app.assistant.heroBodyFull: Yi magana don rubuta sayarwa da kashe kuɗi, ko buɗe Mutane biyu don magana — ana rubuta maganarka, ana fassara, ana kuma faɗa da harshen da ka zaɓa.
app.assistant.emptyBooks: Taɓa mic ka faɗi sayarwa ko kashe kuɗi. Abin da ka ce da amsar TIJAR suna bayyana a nan.
app.assistant.emptyChat: Mutum A yana magana, Mutum B yana ji da harshensa — sai ku musanya. Duk a wannan tattaunawa.
app.assistant.tapMicBooks: Taɓa mic — zan rubuta abin da ka ce in kuma yi maka magana
app.assistant.chatHint: Ka yi magana {from} → su ji {to} (murya kawai — babu rubutu)
app.assistant.hausaVoiceOnly: Muryar Hausa (yi magana & ji) tana aiki a wannan waya. Fassara rubutu na Hausa ba ta nan a API na NKENNEAi ba tukuna — asalin yana a bayyane.
app.assistant.sameLanguageHint: Bangarorin biyu suna amfani da harshe ɗaya — ana faɗa asalin a murya.
app.assistant.emptyChatSpeakOnly: A shirye — taɓa Yi magana, sai Fassara & faɗa. Za ka ji harshen ɗaya kawai.
app.assistant.chatHintSpeakOnly: Babu rubutu a allo. Fassara da murya kawai.
app.assistant.speakOriginalFallback: An kasa fassara — ana faɗa maganarka a murya.
